parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.stopTransitionsToIdle` at line 71 and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` at line 164) and are intentionally testing different behavioral concerns — state transition vs. idempotency — which naturally produces structurally similar but semantically distinct test bodies. Collapsing them would obscure the separate behavioral contracts each test class is meant to verify.
